description: Bridge configuration between Native Media AI Studio app and standalone ComfyUI core.

bridge.description: When enabled, custom nodes from config/comfyui/custom_nodes/ are linked into ComfyUI's custom_nodes/ directory on startup. This keeps ComfyUI core standalone and updatable while preserving custom modifications.

custom_nodes.description: Custom ComfyUI nodes maintained by the app. These are symlinked into ComfyUI's custom_nodes/ directory on startup so ComfyUI core remains untouched.

nodes.name: NMA Audio Sync
nodes.description: Syncs visual generation to audio beats/sections

nodes.name: NMA Stem Router
nodes.description: Routes audio stems to different visual channels

nodes.name: NMA Remix Controller
nodes.description: Controls remix parameters for real-time mashup generation

workflows.description: Pre-built ComfyUI workflows for common tasks.

workflows.name: Audio Reactive Visualizer
workflows.description: Generates audio-reactive visualizations from audio stems

workflows.name: Music Video Scene
workflows.description: Full music video scene generation with camera moves and effects

workflows.name: Stem Mixer Preview
workflows.description: Preview stem mixes with visual feedback

models.description: Custom model configurations referenced by workflows.
